music.style: Documentary background score for a true-story explainer video, instrumental. Serious, curious and engaging, with narrative tension; NOT relaxing, NOT calm piano music. Dominated by layered strings (low cellos and violas with slow rising bowed phrases and subtle tremolo), deep evolving synth drones and textured pads, soft low pulses and heartbeat-like swells, subtle sound-design risers, whooshes and reversed textures. Piano almost absent: at most a rare single low note. No drums, no beat, no claps, no bells, no flute, clarinet, oboe, harp, lute, accordion, no folk or medieval feel. Cinematic, modern, wide and deep sound. Sits under a low male narrator, no lead melody, mid frequencies left open for the voice.

A modest wooden room in a 4th‑century Hungarian town, lit by a flickering oil lamp, cradles a newborn baby swaddled in simple cloth. The walls are rough timber, and a faint glimpse of a thatched roof can be seen through a small window. The atmosphere is warm and intimate, emphasizing the humble beginning of Martin.

In a bustling Roman military camp outside the Hungarian town, a stern Roman officer—Martin's father—stands in polished bronze breastplate and a red‑plumed helmet, his scarred brow fixed on his son. Teenage Martin, thin and solemn, wears a plain rough tunic and looks up as the officer grips a short sword, indicating the boy's forced enlistment. The scene is bathed in the amber glow of a late‑morning sun, casting long shadows on the packed earth. Character look (face and body, keep exactly; the clothes and age are the ones described above): Teenage Martin: male, 15 years old, thin slim boy, olive skin, short dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, a distinctive straight nose and calm dark eyes, earnest face; same face and bone structure as Young Martin; Martin's father: male, about 45 years old, broad-shouldered, short grey-streaked hair, firm square jaw, a scar over the left eyebrow, stern proud face.

A cold, moonlit night blankets the narrow cobblestones of Amiens, France; mist curls around the dim lanterns hanging from stone walls. Young Martin, in his bronze‑studded leather cuirass and red‑brown cloak, pauses beside a gaunt Beggar shivering in tattered rags, his breath visible in the frosty air. The beggar's hollow cheeks and trembling hands are highlighted by a weak orange lantern glow, creating a stark contrast with Martin's disciplined posture. Character look (face and body, keep exactly; the clothes and age are the ones described above): Young Martin: male, 18 years old, lean athletic build, olive skin, short dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, a distinctive straight nose and calm dark eyes, gentle compassionate face; The Beggar: male, about 40 years old, gaunt very thin, pale skin, hollow cheeks, long unkempt grey-brown hair, scraggly beard, trembling from cold.

Under the same misty night sky, Young Martin draws his short sword and slices his bright red‑brown military cloak cleanly in half, the steel flashing briefly. He extends the torn half to the Beggar, whose eyes widen with surprise as he reaches out with his thin, cold fingers. The surrounding lanterns cast a soft, golden halo around the two figures, emphasizing the act of sharing. Character look (face and body, keep exactly; the clothes and age are the ones described above): Young Martin: male, 18 years old, lean athletic build, olive skin, short dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, a distinctive straight nose and calm dark eyes, gentle compassionate face; The Beggar: male, about 40 years old, gaunt very thin, pale skin, hollow cheeks, long unkempt grey-brown hair, scraggly beard, trembling from cold.
